mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rates (below 0.5%) signal an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 7.5% signals a labor market crisis that triggers aggressive monetary policy, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate rate cuts.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 7.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 7.5%) indicate a severe recession with active monetary support, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy stabilizes.
failure_condition: The joint condition (FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and UNRATE > 7.5%) fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Housing market recovery (HOUST > 540 thousand units) signals strengthening consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as retail sales growth accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 540.

mechanism_narrative: Stable consumer price index (CPIAUCSL < 212.0) indicates low inflation risk, supporting equity valuations by reducing the threat of monetary tightening and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL < 212.0.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO > 103.0) signals a strengthening manufacturing sector that boosts corporate profits, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 103.0.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales (RSAFS > 340,000 million dollars) indicates robust consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 340000.

mechanism_narrative: Declining non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS < 134,000 thousand persons) signals labor market deterioration that triggers policy support, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates stimulus.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS < 134000.
